notices.short_title: Removal, transport, disposal of used engine oil waste
notices.description:
The Fire Department of the City of New York seeks a qualified Contractor to furnish all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to remove, transport, and dispose of used engine oil waste (in gallons) from various FDNY facilities throughout the five boroughs of New York City. 

The term of this agreement shall be from the date of the Notice to Proceed, until the expiration of three (3) consecutive years unless otherwise canceled or terminated.
notices.plain: The Fire Department awarded ENP Environmental Inc a contract of $300,000 through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition, to remove, transport and dispose of used engine oil waste from FDNY facilities across the five boroughs for three years.

notices.description: Legal service contracts provide legal services to non-citizens to assist with applications for citizenship, permanent residence, and many other immigration-related legal services. DYCD wishes to extend our current portfolio while the new RFP is being developed.

notices.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notices.description: COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Counseling in Schools Inc a $24,073,893 contract to run COMPASS middle school programs in public schools, selected from competing proposals drawn from a pre-qualified list.

notices.description:
NOTICE OF RATIFICATION OF A MINOR RULES VIOLATION


On August 17, 2026, pursuant to Section 1-02(h)(1)(ii) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules (PPB Rules), the City Chief Procurement Officer (CCPO) ratified a Minor Rules Violation request submitted by the New York City Department of Probation (DOP) in connection with the Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) for the Parent Support Program.

The Minor Rules Violation concerned compliance with PPB Rule §3-04 relating to services being rendered prior to the execution and registration of the authorized contract action. notable.description: COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Counseling in Schools Inc. a $23.7 million contract to run COMPASS after-school programs in elementary public schools, chosen from competing proposals among pre-approved vendors.

notable.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notable.vendor_name: The Young Womens Christian Association of The City
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded the Young Women's Christian Association of the City of New York a $22,796,019 contract to run COMPASS after-school programs at middle schools in Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens, selected from competing proposals limited to pre-qualified vendors.

notable.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Elementary
notable.vendor_name: South Asian Youth Action SAYA Inc
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded South Asian Youth Action SAYA Inc a $19.8 million contract to run COMPASS afterschool programs at Queens 3 and 10 Elementary School, chosen from competing proposals among vendors approved in advance.

notable.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public School - Elementary
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Southern Queens Park Assoc. Inc. a $19.5 million contract to run COMPASS afterschool programs in Queens 12 and 13 public elementary schools, chosen from competing proposals among vendors the city approved in advance.

notable.short_title: Brownsville Womens Center Fire Alarm and Sprinkler Upgrade
notable.description: This project consists of new fire alarm system for the base building and daycare care facilities, new residential style smoke detectors for the individual apartments (not tied to fire alarm system), new emergency lighting and exit signage throughout all common and business areas. CB: Brooklyn 16
notable.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded Atlantic Specialty Inc. a $3.9 million contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to upgrade the fire alarm and sprinkler systems at the Brownsville Women's Center.

notable.short_title: Medical Furniture and Medical Equipment for School Medical Rooms
notable.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded SimBio USA Inc a $1.5 million contract for medical furniture and equipment for school medical rooms, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notable.short_title: MOWING SERVICES AT DSNY LANDFILL LOCATIONS
notable.description: 82726Y0434-Mowing existing grass, weeds, and turf within the fresh kills landfill, Staten Island, NY, and Edgemere Landfill, Queens, NY
notable.plain: The Department of Sanitation awarded McCarey Landscaping Inc a $1.5 million contract for mowing grass, weeds and turf at the Fresh Kills landfill on Staten Island and the Edgemere Landfill in Queens, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notable.short_title: Engineering Consulting for Brooklyn and Queensboro Bridges
notable.plain: The Department of Transportation awarded CHI Consulting Engineers LLC a $1,243,369 contract for engineering consulting on the Brooklyn and Queensboro Bridges, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notable.short_title: Legal Services for Domestic Violence
notable.description: Legal service contracts provide legal services to non-citizens to assist with applications for citizenship, permanent residence, and many other immigration-related legal services. The services consist of legal services for immigrants, immigrant youth, survivors of domestic violence and trafficking and legal services for immigrant workers. DYCD wishes to extend our current portfolio while the new RFP is being developed.
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Urban Justice Center a $890,910 contract for legal services for domestic violence survivors, immigrants and other non-citizens, through a negotiated acquisition rather than open competition.
